## 0.4.5

- Dicta now tells you when an update is ready: a Windows notification, and an "Update to …" button on the Overview page. It checks every 6 hours and soon after your PC wakes, instead of once a day.
- Your data is safer. History, stats, snippets and word rules can no longer be wiped when a file can't be read or saved, and multiline snippets keep every line.
- Safer undo and pasting. Undo only removes text Dicta knows it pasted, and a partly typed dictation is never typed twice.
- Rewrite keeps your meaning. Full cleanup can't drop a "not" or change a number, and separate numbers stay separate ("twenty, thirty" is no longer "2030").
- Smaller fixes: "scratch that" only removes what you just said, filler removal keeps words that matter, and on-screen name fixes leave email addresses alone.
- Settings now tells you if Windows won't let Dicta start at login, and History shows when a search or delete fails.
- More reliable graphics-card setup and startup, plus security updates.
